description: Open the bet-amount list and scroll to the HIGHEST option then the LOWEST, so a SCROLLABLE list reveals both ends on screen (not every option is visible at once). Places no bet. Exposes facts.denom_count / min_bet / max_bet / currency for an AI check that the list matches the configured denominations.

cases.title: The bet list offers exactly the denominations the config defines

video.prompt:
Grandma Pets is a 5-reel, 4-row slot. In this clip the player opens the bet list, scrolls through it, and closes it again.
(1) list_opens: does a list of selectable bet amounts open? (2) values_descend: are the values in descending order from top to bottom? (3) lowest_value: read the SMALLEST bet in the list exactly as printed, as a string. (4) highest_value: read the LARGEST bet you can see, as a string. If the list scrolls and you cannot reach the end, answer "unreadable". (5) list_closes: is the list gone at the end of the clip? (6) ui_broken: is anything overlapping, cut off, placeholder or visibly broken?
notes: one short sentence on anything the questions above do not cover.

data.notes: The bet list does not scroll because all available values are visible on a single screen.
